# Build decisions log

| D234 | 5.17, D1 | The sector table's typical payout ratio, and part payments | One shared default for all 42 industries (D1), 40%: the median of the 3-markets 3.3.2 typical payout column. The dividend is all or nothing: paid in full only if own cash after it stays strictly above min_cash, never cut to fit; only Active companies pay (5.12 step 1) | `SECTOR_PAYOUT` | F4 | |
| D300 | 9.1, build-plan M7.1, 4.5 | How does the bridge pace ticks, and how does max speed keep the window drawing? | Bevy's default 64 Hz `FixedUpdate`; at speeds 1 to 4 each fixed step adds `dt / seconds_per_hour` owed hours and runs the whole ones; at max (speed 5 or a SkipTo) it steps until 8 ms of wall time are spent in the frame. The first tick of a frame always runs; owed hours are capped at 4 so a slow frame never bursts; pausing drops what is owed. Controls written by the UI apply in the next frame's `PreUpdate` (D5); views are copied in once per frame in `Update`, before every UI system, and only views whose version moved (after a NewGame or Load, every view, since both rebuild all views at refresh 1). Max-speed throughput depends on how many fixed steps run each second (about 64), not on the frame rate: a frame with no fixed step runs no ticks | `FRAME_STEP_BUDGET`, `MAX_OWED_HOURS` | M7 | |
| D301 | build-plan M7.7 | Table sort tie-break, and where unknown ("?") cells go | Ties go to the lower row index whatever the earlier sorts were (D2), so a sort never depends on history; "?" cells sort last in both directions | `table::sort_order` | M7 | |
| D302 | 11-ui 11.4, build-plan M7.4 | Which font, and how are icons drawn with no icon set yet? | Bevy's built-in default font (Fira Mono, monospace, so number columns align and it suits the terminal look). It covers ASCII only, so rail icons and alert icons are short ASCII tags (CO, IND, PDB, RCP, NEWS; $, RCP, LCK, BK!, W) and the "Read-only MVP" lock icon is drawn from two nodes; an icon font is a later asset | `theme::font`, `Screen::tag` | M7 | |
| D303 | 8, 20-ui 20.2.2 | Spec 8's rail lists Company, Industries, Pdoomberg and Recap, but the News feed screen has no way in (design fix 300); the Recap has no key | The rail adds News (key N, as 20.2.2); the Recap takes key R (Milestones, 20.2.2's R, is not in the MVP). Screen keys toggle their screen; Esc closes a menu first, then the open screen | `Screen::RAIL`, `Screen::key` | M7 | |
| D304 | 8, 20-ui 20.2.1, 20.4.1 | Alert icon targets, clearing and toasts | Click opens the alert's screen and clears its icon: Earnings day opens Pdoomberg, Quarterly recap and Plan lock the Recap, Bankruptcy in watchlist the Company screen, World event the News feed; right-click dismisses. Earnings day also clears after the day it fired (20.4.1 "or next day"). Pause and Notify alerts get an icon and a toast (6 s, at most 5 shown); Log alerts only the event log, shown in the outliner | `alerts::target`, `TOAST_SECONDS`, `MAX_TOASTS` | M7 | |
| D305 | 7, 9.1 | The seed of a game started with no seed given | 1; `--seed N` picks another | `DEFAULT_SEED` (game main.rs) | M7 | |
| D306 | 8, 20-ui 20.4.1 | 20-ui locks the Quarterly recap at Pause, spec 8 makes every alert settable, and the sim has a fifth alert (World event, 5.1.1) that spec 8's list omits (design fix 301) | Spec 8 wins for the MVP: all five alerts are settable to Pause, Notify, Log or Off, with the sim's defaults | `alerts::LEVELS` | M7 | |
| D307 | build-plan M7.7, M7.8 | Demo data for the table widget and the watchlist before the company and quote views exist | The home screen (the map's place until M8) lists the 3,255 provinces from sim-data, and Pdoomberg F2 lists the 651 companies from companies.csv; clicking a company row adds it to or drops it from the watchlist (row index is the CompanyId, D4). Private companies show "?" for revenue, estimated value and controller stake (spec 1, published data only) unless Omniscient is on. All of it lives in `ui/demo.rs`, deleted when the company views land (M9). The mouse wheel moves 2 rows per line; the pool is capped at 160 rows | `ROWS_PER_WHEEL_LINE`, `MAX_POOL` | M7 | |
